title: A push that changes only the ledger runs ci and republishes both images
foundBy: user report (host): "support ledger builds on pushes that only contain ledger changes, with just linting, ledger checking, and a pages build to publish the ledger page"

evidence.verified: Pushing a164fd2, which changed only `ledger/`, started the ledger and pages workflows and no ci. Both passed, and the status file still lists 213c0de first in `built`. With no ci, publish images did not run either.

resolution: ci skips a push that changes only `ledger/`. The ledger workflow runs the ledger check and the document linters, and pages republishes the ledger's page. Nothing is built or published, so `built` stays.
details: Closing an issue is a commit that changes only `ledger/`, and pushing it runs the whole of `ci`. `ci` finishing then publishes a build of code that has not changed: both images, on both architectures. Such a push needs only the ledger check, the document linters and a site build, which publishes the ledger's page.
